narr_th_mango_4: At eleven, as the waiters began to clear, Carmen Trujillo was standing by the door at the back of the hall. She hadn't been at the dinner.
narr_th_mango_5: She lowered her sunglasses, slowly, onto the bridge of her nose, and looked at him over the top of them. Then she pushed them back up and went out into the night.
narr_th_night_2: In the lobby, Nieves looked at their faces, and for the first time since Alan had arrived she didn't raise her eyebrow. She looked down at her register and turned a page.
narr_th_night_3: The lift sneezed at every floor, and neither of them laughed.
narr_th_night_4: Vasco hung his good jacket on the back of the chair, carefully, squaring the shoulders. Then he lay down on his side of the bed, on top of the sheet, with his back to Alan, and turned off his lamp.
vasco_th_night_2: I know you can. You can always explain. [pause] That's what frightens me.
vasco_th_night_3: Not tonight, Alan. Please. I've got to be up at five.
narr_th_night_5: Alan sat on the edge of the bed in the dark for a long time. Through the open balcony doors came the sound of the sea.
narr_th_night_6: And under it, so faint he might have imagined it, the slow hiss and draw of waves on a beach that was not this beach, in a place that was not this place, a long way down in the dark.
narr_th_night_7: He did not close the balcony doors. He lay down on his own side, with his back to Vasco's back, a hand's breadth apart, awake, until the grey light came.

notes:
Thursday follows Chapter Three in order. Scene by scene:
- Morning: unchanged (alan_th_wake).
- Chano's news (S.chanoNewsThu, hooked from tue.js): the novel's kiosk scene, Pepe drowned with the window shut, 'my cousin's wife's sister', and Chano points Alan to Doña Pino (same boat, 1971). It sets pepe_known (the paper still does too). chano_gossip_3 becomes the dinner gossip.
- Doña Pino's missal (S.pinoMissal, already called from wed.js): the Virgen del Pino, the four who came up, the new black line through José Santana, 'Pepe is the sea', 'the sea never forgets a debt... one day it comes to collect', 'you looked at my helmet like a letter addressed to you' (yesterday: the helmet is Wednesday in the game), the cistern memory, 'Yes. I think I do.' Kept to the game's facts: Pepe 61 (the paper), his wife finds him (narr_pepe_2), the list's names as docs.js has them (not the novel's Tomás Martel / Juan Medina). The wreck is now the novel's storm off Cape Bojador (the old line said a flat calm off Gando; nothing else referred to it).
- Carmen (S.carmenLore, after wed.js's toll): the bible's worked example and the novel, nearly word for word: 'You read it', the Franciscan, the chair, the harimaguadas, the five-year conquest counted on her fingers (Rejón 1478 = the helmet, Ansite, Atis Tirma), 'Who told you that?', Rayco's end-of-term legend, Risco Caído, the grandmothers' saying, 'I believe in documents', and Casa de Colón with 'She hates everyone who isn't dead'. The pointer to Colón is now part of the core (it used to be an optional 'Castilians' question). Ask about: Montesdeoca ('Don't get me started...', and 'I'd look at him first', which feeds the wrong suspicion), the friar (new), Magec, Baute, Elena (as before), and Pepe (the bible's [PLAY]: her eyes go to the conservation list, 'I have work. Go away, Señor Sanches.', said quietly; it ends the talk).
- Inês (core.js S.callThu, see core_changes): the letter written 'with a chicken', the grandfather's boxes, the ledger, 1751 'para estudar a fechadura', the 1755 page, 'it knows the people who shut it... It knew you', 'Here, I'd keep away from the water', then her old 'tell Vasco tonight' turned into 'whatever you're planning, tell him first'.
- Casa de Colón: arrival narration outside (first entry) and in the courtyards (the parrots, who now say '¡Guiri! ¡Guiri feo!'); Mercedes met as in the novel ('my sympathy, but not my time'), and the inquiry read aloud as the core of the first talk (it sets inquiry_read, so the old 'May I read it?' only shows for a save that met her before): the witness, the black sea against the wind, the women in white, three months, Saint John's morning, the San Juan miracle, Juan de Quintana pulled out by a Canario and drowned in his bed (the rule 'it comes for those taken back from it', heard from a character), 'Nadie preguntó a las mujeres', 'Because it's doing it again', 'stay out of the low places', and a parrot laughs last. Ask about: the witches of '83 (1505), the parrots. The reading avoids the other two ships' names: the novel's (San Pedro, Magdalena) differ from docs.js's closeup (La Gallega, San Telmo).
- The tide and Gail and Derek: the promenade steps' Thursday look is the novel's tide; Gail and Derek at their restaurant table (core_changes 2-4) do the novel's exchange through the window ('they've put the sea on it', 'Is this normal?' 'No. It isn't.'), Montesdeoca's invitation, 'a Portuguese doctor... very clever' 'He is.', and Gail's 'a good-looking boy like you' (Alan embarrassed).
- The plan and the suitcase (S.suitcaseThu, on entering the lobby once Carmen, Colón and the call are done): the novel's plan in narration ('the way you have a fever', 'He did not, at any point, consider simply telling Vasco'); the suitcase from Madrid. Changed from the novel because Alan has no linen-suit art: the port has leaked all over the cream linen suit, so Nieves gives him back to the stranger's blazer ('No one needs that jacket. Tonight, it seems, you do.'). It puts the blazer on (blazer_on). New gate: S.dinnerDue now also needs suitcase_done (or dinner_intro, for old saves), with a hint and the map's next pin (core_changes 7-8) and the debug preset (11).
- The dinner (enter(), still chained to Tuesday's): the transformed hall, Vasco nervous ('the terrible jacket', 'I've missed your suit', cough at twenty minutes, 'After tonight, I'll be better. I promise.'), the plan 'like something swallowed', 'Break a leg'; Baute's toast kept; Vasco's talk from the novel; Montesdeoca and his cigar, Baute's grief, the sleeping guard, Derek filming. Derek's puzzle kept, but as the novel's fall: Alan sends him to 'the best angle in the building', he walks into the guard's chair, chaos. NPC lines during the dinner rewritten (Vasco on slide fourteen, Baute 'this is the good part', Montesdeoca rude about the sermon and the ham).
- Baute's office: arrival narration (the back stairs, DR. R. BAUTE, the orange light). The knife opens the drawer as before; inside, the novel's Montesdeoca file (twelve pages of nothing: 'the most boring document I have ever read, and I sell books'), then the photograph and the map (docs.js closeup unchanged), the plan 'snaps back into place', and the light comes on.

Alan says nothing (alan_caught_1 retired). Then over black: the mango, the end of the talk, Carmen at the door with her sunglasses.
